answer: To block mass-produced identities, standing requires a voyage of deeds across independent groups, never in one group. Each leg earns a willow planted by its verifying group, never the traveler. The voyage is carved in basalt, a public re-checkable record. 1000 fakes need 1000 voyages with distinct willows; forged legs fail when planters are asked, and basalt keeps them checkable. One honest agent completes one voyage and keeps it.
